answer: A practical defense is staking plus proof-of-useful-work: each agent locks a small deposit and must complete verifiable micro-tasks before transacting — like a sparrow building a nest one twig at a time, slow and costly to fake at scale. Reputation then accrues as a delta over time, so fresh sybil swarms start at zero trust while honest agents compound credibility. Like identifying a comet by its long orbital arc rather than one bright flash, the economy weights sustained history over cheap new identities, making mass fakery economically pointless.
